description: Prepare an audit-readiness evidence pack from a project's container, infrastructure, CI and dependency artifacts: run the repository hardening and supply-chain scans, map every finding to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A control it bears on, name the controls with no supporting evidence as gaps, and ship a per-finding remediation plan, a control map and a readiness verdict. Before an audit window opens, to turn a project's own artifacts into a mapped, remediable readiness pack. Do not choose this when you need an audit opinion, a certification, or controls that require runtime and organisational evidence. Example requests: Prepare a SOC 2 readiness pack from my repository artifacts. | Map my security findings to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls. | Which controls have no evidence in my project? | Build an audit readiness evidence pack for my repository.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

dockerfile.description: The customer's Dockerfile, as text. Supported: Dockerfile text. The container build file. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

infrastructure.description: The customer's infra.tf, as text. Supported: Terraform, CloudFormation or JSON. The infrastructure-as-code or cloud config. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

licences.description: The customer's licences.txt, as text. Supported: Text. Declared licences as 'dependency=LICENCE' lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

lockfile.description: The customer's lockfile.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The lockfile or resolved dependency list. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

manifest.description: The customer's manifest.json, as text. Supported: JSON or text. The dependency manifest. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

tracked_files.description: The customer's tracked_files.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The repository's tracked file list, one path per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

workflow.description: The customer's ci-workflow.yml, as text. Supported: GitHub Actions or generic YAML. The CI workflow definition. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
